comments.author: @trapical
comments.text:
I've been running a "Movie Night" with friends and family. For the past five years we have watched one movie every week, as a group, and then rated it afterwards.
This was the first and only movie to score a perfect 100/100 from every single person in attendence.

comments.author: @KevinMarshall999
comments.text: Caught this at a RiverRun screening in Winston-Salem, NC and loved it.  For those asking, it's currently on the festival circuit as of April 2023.  Not sure when it'll go to release/streaming, but it'll be worth the wait.  Insanely inventive, densely packed with clever gags, deft mix of animation and live action, callbacks to silent movie action slapstick, inspired sound design, Spy vs Spy, comic book tropes, Guy Maddin-style visual mash-ups, and of course dogs playing poker.  A feast for the eyes and ears.  Love cult/midnight movies?  Kinda jaded and need confirmation movies can still surprise you?  This is your jam.
